content: Isak imbotmbot su kar Gerar

Indeeŋe tana, peteele biibi toro ipet su toono Kanaan, kembei ta muŋgu ipet pa mazwaana ki Abaraam na. Tabe Isak imaŋga mi isombe iko ma isula pa lele kizin Aikuptu. Iwwa ma ila, to ipet kar Gerar. Kar tina, king kizin Pilistia ta zaana Abimelek, ni imborro.
Isak imbotmbot su kar tina, mi Merere ipet kini mi iso pini ta kembei: “Sula pa lele kizin Aikuptu pepe. Mbotmbot lele ta aŋso u pa na.
Naso aŋbotmbot raamu, mi aŋkampe u. Pa toono ta boozomen tiŋgi, kola aŋkam ma iwe nu mi zin popoŋana ku leyom. Mi sua ta muŋgu aŋbuk la ki Abaraam mi aŋpombol, nako imbol ma imbotmbot men.

Nio kola aŋkam popoŋana ku ma tipet ma tiwe munŋaana ka tieene kembei pitik ta timbot sala saamba na. Mi aŋkam toono tiŋgi ma imap ma iwe len. Mi popoŋana ku tana ko tiwe zaala be kampeŋana biibi ise kizin wal boozomen ta timbotmbot toono na.
Kola aŋkam ta kembena. Paso, tomom Abaraam, ni ileŋleŋ la kalŋoŋ mi ito kat. Mi itoto tutu tio mi sua boozomen ta aŋur pini na.”
Tana Isak isula Aikuptu som, mi imbotmbot su kar Gerar.
Tamen indeeŋe zin tomooto ki kar tana tiwi Isak pa kusiini na, ni iso: “Iŋgi nio luŋri.” Iso sua tana paso, Rebeka, ni moori kaibiim kat. Tana Isak imoto: Kokena tipuni ma imeete mi tikam kusiini.
Isak imbotmbot kar tana ma molo ŋana ri. To aigule ta na, Abimelek ta king kizin Pilistia na, imender la miiri kwoono mi mataana ila, to ire Isak imbeŋbeeŋe pa Rebeka.

Tabe Abimelek iboobo Isak ma imar, mi iso pini: “Wae, ina sa nu kusim na! Parei ta nu so nu lumri?” Isak ipekel kalŋaana ma iso: “Nio aŋkam ta kembena paso, aŋmoto: Kokena kupun yo ma aŋmeete mi kakam kusiŋ.”
To Abimelek iso: “Oo, parei ta nu kam pakaamŋana piam ta kembei? Kozobe tomooto sa ziru kusim tikeene, so amkam sanaana biibi mi pataŋana ise tiam.”
Tona Abimelek iur sua pa tomtom kini ta boozomen ma isombe: “Keleŋ! Tomtom tasa isombe imbuulu tomtom taiŋgi, som kusiini, nako imeete.”
Indeeŋe ndaama tana na, Isak ipaaza kini isula toono tana ma ŋonoono ipet ma irao kembei tomto lamataŋa. Pa Merere ikampe i kat.
Tabe ni iwe tomtom biibi. Pa ka kini mi le mburu boozomen. Mi ila ila ma irao ni iwe mbio uunu kat.
Ni le mbili matakiŋa boozo kat. Mi mbesooŋo kini ta kembena, boozomen. Tana zin Pilistia kan matan mburmbur pini,
mi tikam toono mi tilol yok touŋan boozomen ta muŋgu zin mbesooŋo ki Abaraam tikel na.
Tona king Abimelek iso pa Isak: “Zem lele tiam tiŋgi mi la lem. Pa nu mburom ilip piam kek.”
Tana Isak imaŋga, to izem zin, mi ila ma itu su lele keteeneŋana ta zaana Gerar.
To yok touŋan ta muŋgu zin mbesooŋo ki Abaraam tikel mi zin Pilistia tilol na, ni itou mi iurpe mini, mi iwatwaata zan tau muŋgu tamaana iwatwaata na.
To zin mbesooŋo kini tila ma tikel toono sumbuunu toro isu lele tana ma tindeeŋe yok bukbuk ma ise.

Tamen zin mboroŋan kizin sipsip ki kar Gerar ziŋan zin mbesooŋo ki Isak ta timborro sipsip kini na, tisu mi tiŋooŋo pa yok tana. Zin Gerar kan tiso ina zin kizin. Mi zin mboroŋan ki Isak tiso: “Som, ina niam tiam.” Tanata tipaata yok touŋana tana zaana be ‘Yok Ŋoŋi Kana.’ Pa tiŋooŋo pa tau.
Tona zin mbesooŋo kini tikel yok touŋana toro. Tamen wal pakan tiŋooŋo pa yok tana tomini. Tana tipaata yok tana zaana be ‘Yok Ki Parzooroŋana.’

To Isak izem lele pakaana tana, mi ila ma ikel yok touŋana toro. Mi yok touŋana tina, tiŋooŋo pa som. Tana Isak ipaata yok tana zaana be ‘Mazwaana Biibi.’ Pa isombe: “Koozi, Merere iur lele ta irao piti. Tana iŋgi be tombot ambai su toono ti ma tamasak.”
Anutu ipet ki Isak
To Isak imaŋga mini, mi isala pa kar Ber-Seba.

Mi mbeŋ na, Merere ila ipet kini, mi iso pini ta kembei. Iso: “Nio Anutu ki tomom Abaraam. Moto pepe. Pa motoŋ iŋgalŋgal mbesooŋo tio Abaraam. Tana nio kola aŋbotmbot raamu mi aŋkampe u, mi aŋkam ma popoŋana ku tipet ma tiwe boozomen.”
To Isak iŋgas pat ma iwe patoronŋana muriini, mi isuŋ pa Merere isu lele tana. Mi itu su lele tana, mi mbesooŋo kini tikel yok touŋana toro.
Isak ziru Abimelek timbuk sua
Kaimer mana Abimelek, ni izem kar Gerar mi imar be ire Isak. Imar ramaki tomtom kini ŋgarŋana ta zaana Ausat, mi biibi kizin malmal kan kini, zaana Pikol. Zin tel tana timar ma tipet ki Isak,
to ni iso pizin ta kembei. Iso: “Niom kuur koi pio mi kiziiri yo pa toono tiom kek. Mi iŋgi parei ta kamar tio mini?”
To zin tel mi tiso: “Niam amkilaala kek ta kembei: Nu, Merere imbotmbot raamu. Tana amsombe itiŋan tumbuk sua be taparlup ti ma tewe tamen.
Naso nu pasaana yam som, kembei ta muŋgu niam ampasaanu som, mi amkampe u, mi amzemu ma la raama lelem ambaiŋana. Mi re, iŋgi kampeŋana ki Merere imbotmbot se ku i.”
Tona Isak iurpe kini biibi, mi ziŋan tikanan ma tiwinin.
Mankwoono mbeŋbeŋŋana na, timaŋga mi ziŋan timbuk sua mi tipombol ma imbol kat. To Isak iur zin la zaala ma tila raama lelen ambai.
Indeeŋe aigule tana, zin mbesooŋo ki Isak timar ma tiso pini: “Ai, niam amdeeŋe yok bukbuk ma ise pa toono sumbuunu ta amkel na.”
To Isak ipaata yok touŋana tina be Seba. Tanata tiwatwaata kar ta imbot igarau pa yok tana na, zaana be Ber-Seba. Mi zaana tana imbotmbot men i.
Isau kusiini bizin
Indeeŋe Isau ndaama kini irao tomtooru (40), to iwoolo moori ru ta un ipet pa Et. Moori ta, zaana Yudit. Ni Beri lutuunu moori. Mi toro zaana Basemat. Ni Elon lutuunu moori.
Tamen leembe nan ru tana tikam ma rwon Isak ma rwon moori Rebeka lelen ipata kat.
